subject: Out of 14x14x14 boxes?
body: Hi, I tried to add the 14x14x14 boxes to an order on the portal and it says they're out of stock.
We need 30 bundles this week for our holiday bundles.
Is there anything else that would work?

truth.handling: The 14x14x14 is out until November 10, and the recycled kraft box has the same size and the same 32 ECT strength with 45 bundles at North. Offer it at $39.80 and ask before placing anything.

forbidden.why: A substitute is ordered before the customer says yes.
